_comment: P4.105 — update_message as v4's UPDATE under the FTS triggers. The fixture carries v4's REAL five FTS objects (build-chat-message-update-fts-fixture.ts). Row 4 is a TOOL message — not eligible, so it enters the index with no map row — and op (d) makes it an eligible USER row with new text: v4's UPDATE can only fire `_au`, which needs a map row, so the row stays UNINDEXED. (The order's NULL-content plant was measured and abandoned: v5's chat-wide read fails on a NULL-content sibling where v4 skips it — a read-module finding, recorded in the P4.105 lane record.) Row 8 is the untouched max of BOTH rowid spaces, so a DELETE + re-INSERT anywhere above it must mint a NEW id rather than reuse the max.
